correctness.rationale: Two distinct exact character algorithms agree on each of 216 automorphisms; 13 conjugacy classes verified by permutations. A separate GF2 boundary program reconstructs all 35,367 nonempty simplices, all 9 boundary ranks, and homology concentration; rational rank and Euler give degree-five rank 40. Hopf trace sign and empty simplex are proved explicitly. Scripts and outputs are provided.

value.rationale: The 216-element symmetry on natural Pappus matching homology is a well motivated invariant strictly finer than the already known rank forty. A complete 13-class character and zero fixed subspaces for full and part-preserving automorphism groups are mathematical information not implied by the nonequivariant wedge or by values from other graph complexes.
